name: Toscana Aeroporti S.p.A.
summary: Toscana Aeroporti S.p.A. operates and manages Florence and Pisa airports in Italy. The company operates through Aviation Business and Non-Aviation Business segments. The Aviation Business segment includes activities that take place in the airside area; offers ground assistance activities for passengers and aircraft, such as handling, landing, departure, and parking of aircraft, security, and safety activities; passenger embarkation and disembarkation; and commercial embarkation and disembarkation services.
